dispatch_to_codex1_authorizes: technical gate then all MM-DEV scientific runs and analysis; no further scientific-recipe review required
supersedes: F1 audit-only stopping point for the newly scoped MM-DEV run

resource.gpu_type: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 (match audited device identity)
resource.scheduler_walltime: site-required allocation lease only; checkpoint and resume without changing scientific horizon
resource.account_qos: verify current permission; last evidence rose / override-limits-but-killable

data.model_inputs: image pixels and frozen visible prompt only; no sidecar values/rewards/difficulty labels
data.numeric_factor: same audited jointly low/no-carry-no-borrow vs high/carry-borrow for all three operations
data.split_unit: complete family (both D levels; all V,chart,operation variants)
data.deduplication: global unique ordered first-two target pairs within D and globally unique sorted three-target sets, plus full-source/image identity checks; includes historical audit exclusion

schedule.preparation: a0; each repeat shares exact stream across A/AP recipes

training.algorithm: single-pass group-relative clipped policy surrogate plus sampled token KL; custom native pinned trainer, not an assumed TRL default
training.normalization: population standard deviation within each prompt group plus 1e-8
training.kl_reference: S0 for preparation; frozen exact starting state for each continuation; shared across its actions/repeats
training.loss_normalization: mean over generated tokens per sequence, then mean over all 192 sequences
training.zero_contrast_groups: retain; record; no rejection/resampling; still count planned optimizer step
training.old_logprob_source: actual raw sampler selected-token log probability; detach; collect at generation before any update
training.rA: A_full = 1[valid answer equals exact true operation result]
training.rAP: 0.5*A_full + 0.5*mean_required_reading_exact_correct; mean is 0 if readings field missing/wrong arity

lora.scope: language full_attention q_proj/v_proj only; native q includes query+gate

training.backend: inherit audited eager BF16 base / FP32 adapter / native unfused linear kernels; no kernel upgrades
training.worker_forward_mode: eval with autograd enabled for policy update; dropout disabled

sampling.rationale: training raw sampling and raw ratio identify same mathematical policy; evaluation retains audited channel; training-support conclusions cannot be imported numerically from old top-p audit

engineering_gate.natural_recipe: same new trainer and rAP, fixed ENGINE_F2 schedule, continuous4 versus independent-process2+2
engineering_gate.synthetic_stress_if: all actual reward groups are constant across the fixed natural engineering trace; actual normalized policy advantages verified zero
engineering_gate.nonconstant_reward_but_no_policy_gradien: GRPO_GRADIENT_MISMATCH technical blocker; synthetic stress is prohibited as an escape
engineering_gate.synthetic_stress: fresh reset; same real generated inputs, coefficient +1 for all sampled sequences in policy surrogate, real reward/normalized advantages still logged but not applied; isolated engineering only
engineering_gate.scientific_gradient_evidence_claim: never call synthetic stress a nonzero natural-reward GRPO result
engineering_gate.restore_acceptance: tensor-exact state and deterministic tokens on identical audited hardware/backend

sampler_teacher_forcing_numeric_gate.source: new predeclared engineering tolerances, not observed pass

engineering_gate.failure_policy: technical blocker stops affected new run for explicit repair; successful gate automatically continues to MM-DEV

measurement.primary: A_full,P_full,J_full over all completed attempts; missing semantic fields count false for corresponding full indicators
measurement.joint_table: P,C,A conditional on joint L; exact six cells, missing not 000
measurement.features_at: PROBE on each of 5 starting states only
measurement.probe_gold_scoring: one cached true completion per question per starting state, independent of 4 samples
measurement.endpoint_eval: all 5 starts and all 30 ends; evaluate each identity under its own state ID even if some endpoints coincide
measurement.S_aggregation: root-equal among supported roots; separately report full-panel undefined status and support counts
measurement.context_stability: separate audit only with within-prompt collision controls; not BGeo main input

crossfit_root_halves.definition: rank(list(range(128)), crossfit-root-half); first 64 vs last 64; deterministic and no responses used

statistics.preserve_within_root: all 24 variants x K x all state/action/future identities
statistics.primary_fixed_path_summary: mean over 5 registered starts and 2 paired future repeats; conditions on those paths
statistics.root_population_inference: empirical-root descriptive intervals, not independent-training-population CI
statistics.future_seed_summary: both point effects and their differences, not SE from n=2
statistics.adaptive_policy_gap: exploratory; selection and evaluation split by both future repeat and deterministic root half; no proof of deployable oracle

utility.anchor: untrained starting state for that path
utility.cost_unit: generated tokens, forward sequences, optimizer updates and actual allocated GPU seconds all reported; none subtracted in primary utility

no_train.shared_probe_cost: common decision overhead, not claimed zero total deployment cost

utility.feasibility: D_P per stratum >= -0.02; report point and conditional-root uncertainty separately; not a safety guarantee

prediction_analysis.five_state_fit: only optional fixed exploratory diagnostic, cannot establish new-state generalization
prediction_analysis.independent_MM_LOCK: not instantiated; requires separate data-source/sample-size and predictor freeze

persistence.resume_from_latest_committed_step: replay saved incomplete-update rollouts under matching policy hash and finish missing logical slots; never count a replay as a new logical sample

remaining_materialization_fields: new code commit and source hashes
actual named LoRA modules and full zero-output adapter hash
